cli.order: Any order; exactly one nonempty value per flag; no duplicate, missing or extra flag.
cli.phase_rule: Exact membership in PHASE_WORK_SECONDS; no aliases, arbitrary duration, environment override or profile budget.
cli.digest_rule: Four mandatory SHA-256 flag values each exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
cli.start_rule: Exactly 1..20 decimal digits; original parent sample S; future start rejected against ENTRY_NS.
cli.console_output: No raw argv/profile/payload/exception text; main returns actual CLI status, not a self-exit observation.

arithmetic.S: Original parent same-local-Mac monotonic_ns sample before collector spawn/admission.
arithmetic.late_rule: Every existing >= deadline rejection remains. Stage entry does not renew any selected original end.
arithmetic.metadata_compatibility: Both metadata phases keep the exact existing deadline record keys and 130/2/3/135 values.

remote_internal_limits_unchanged.controller_outer_340: Includes file admission, flow, bounded cleanup and evidence; supplies no extra product lifetime.
remote_internal_limits_unchanged.detached_watchdog: Never cancel, replace, restart or extend it. No internal clocks or watchdog/cleanup authority change.
remote_internal_limits_unchanged.binding_limit: A phase label is local budget selection only; the collector treats payload bytes as opaque. Parent must independently bind the exact separately reviewed payload to the selected phase.

route.parent_rule: Qualify exact saved guard and compare all 29 argv tokens before binding whole profile hash. No private guard read here.
route.stdin: Exact bounded hash-checked opaque payload bytes; same exclusive0400 O_RDWR snapshot FD retained, fsynced, rewound and passed directly to SSH.
route.ssh_spawn: One retained /usr/bin/ssh Popen, shell=False, close_fds=True, cwd=/, bufsize=0; exact environment below.
route.effective_inherited_SSH_configuration: UNVERIFIED; no new audit or human gate.

runtime: Trusted local macOS CPython>=3.10 -I -S -B, no optimization; exact Mach descriptor plus same host/boot direct-parent binding. No cross-host clock comparison.

filesystem.input_checks: Absolute canonical component paths; O_NOFOLLOW directory walk, final owner, owned regular input, bounded nonblocking reads, stable initial/final FD and no-follow name identities, exact length/hash.
filesystem.root: New exclusive owned0700 directory; retained containing-parent FD fsynced between admission checks before guard. No resume/reset.
filesystem.publication: O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, default0600; payload.stdin0400. Existing file/root fsyncs and clock checks remain.
filesystem.all_local_files_cap_derivation: 1048576 payload +131072 stdout +65536 stderr +16384 guard +32768 receipt +16384 side record =1310720. Per-file and record caps enforced; no new aggregate runtime counter added.
filesystem.durability_limit: Completed fsync barriers are source intent only here; power-loss durability and hostile same-user mutation resistance UNVERIFIED.

capture.failure: First cap failure before prefix write; keep partial prefixes, hashes/lengths, observed/drop counts, actual EOF and unknown unread bytes distinct. Close pipes without drain.

record_contract.publication_failure_count: Total count remains distinct from at most16 retained detail records.
record_contract.completeness: Existing source predicate: no first failure, actual SSH0 observed before selected work end, both EOF/no drop/no overflow/fsynced; independent D4 still needed.
record_contract.publication_failure: One exclusive bounded side record; no receipt replacement/retry. Partial/stale receipt cannot replace actual collector exit/D4 or prove success.

signals.target: Only exact retained LOCAL SSH handle
signals.eligibility: cap or selected work deadline/timeout only
signals.post_poll_gate: Immediately sample after actual eligibility poll; None can reach KILL only if that retained sample < settle_stop_ns AND < selected absolute. Reuse same sample in kill record.
signals.actual_status: Record only real retained-handle poll/wait code. No status inference from KILL/PID/EOF/file.

D4: Actual retained collector OS exit plus immediate same-running-local-Mac clock T strictly before original selected A, before ANY receipt read. Late/unknown rejects even COMPLETE. No D4 is manufactured here.
publication_authority: Local raw adapter, NOT the R9 reserved writer. Full payload/raw records, encoding, receipts and ordinary aggregate accounting remain under existing parent reservations.
caller_limit_reference: caller-summary-limit.json retains exact historical size proof and integration limits. No compression, raw dropping, cap relaxation or extra writer.
